steps.name: The Hill of Waiting
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Juriring] in 「Whispering Hill」.

steps.name: A Brief Rest
steps.objective: Talk to [Juriring] in 「Whispering Hill」, then turn in the quest to [Marta] in 「Devesis」.

lines.text: (Juriring approaches the adventurer, who lies in the grass gazing at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: You weren't in the village, so I looked for you, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: What are you doing here, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just... thinking.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: About what, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well... Hmm. I'm not sure I should tell you.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Iris says it's all right, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You spoke to Iris?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: You're coming here, ring? Oh, oooooh...
(Juriring raises its head. A small light drifts in from somewhere and descends before the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This light...
(Where the light fades, a woman stands smiling brightly at the adventurer and Juriring.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There you are, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing's wrong, is it?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No. The repairs to the great wall have progressed enough that I can take a short breath.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Wow, it's Iris, ring.
(Juriring approaches and rubs against Iris. She strokes it.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you for helping, Juriring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Juriring loves Devesis. I only did what I should, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Iris, eat with us, ring. The chef's food is delicious, ring.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry, Juriring. I have something else to do now.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: All right, ring. That's a shame, but let's go together next time, ring.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I need to tell you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (About Daphne and Barbatos, probably...?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This is a request as the God of the Astral Realm, not as Iris. %s, you need to rest for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rest? You know what's happening. Daphne and Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll track them for now. They've gathered so much power that ordinary methods can no longer follow them.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll pursue them beyond the great wall. %s, rest in the meantime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I insist, you'll make me rest anyway, won't you?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll do as you ask.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then can you tell me what's happening with Daphne and Barbatos now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: First, Daphne seems to have stopped taking witches' lives since the last time. I don't know what changed her mind.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's as though she's preparing for the end.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And Barbatos is preparing to enter the realm of the gods. I don't know where exactly...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But I should be able to follow him soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Rest for a little while until then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, I have a question.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If... Hecate is destroyed by Daphne, what happens to the witches?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Daphne believes removing the cause will end it. Even though she knows the outcome may differ from what she believes...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Without knowing what Hecate is thinking, there's nothing I can do... Still, I'll try everything I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll rest, then. Call me when it's time.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. Please wait.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I won't keep you waiting too long. I'll go now. See you next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Be careful.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Goodbye, Iris, ring.
(Iris accepts everyone's farewells and disappears with an approaching light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Somehow, I feel frustrated...)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, it's almost mealtime, ring!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't it a little early? You've been eating more often since sharing meals with Patello.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: ...Oh, have I, ring?
(Juriring quietly looks down at its belly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you'd tell me about Barbatos, who used to be Kaulini, when the time came. When is that?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm not sure, ring. Maybe after you've had a good rest and come back, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After a good rest...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't think I can just sit around... Is Medea doing well? Maybe I'll visit Kali...)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oh, I forgot Marta was looking for you, ring. Let's go, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Marta? All right. Let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm... What could it be?)

steps.name: A Forgotten Memory
steps.objective: Talk to [Marta] in 「Devesis」, then turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Kali」.

lines.text: (Marta stands with her eyes closed, resting a hand on the structure before her.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The world within this structure called Likimo Pelke... It will never open again, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marta.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you were looking for me.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Yes. I had something to tell you, so I asked Juriring to find you.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: But where did Juriring go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Said it was hungry and went straight to the Cloud's Threshold.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Patello went to eat, too. Raselis must be busy. He was asking when he could return to the tower...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: When I said I didn't know yet, he looked so disappointed as he left. I felt sorry for him... I hope Raselis doesn't hate him too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marta, shall I go to Glaston and ask?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Thank you for offering. I've already sent someone, so please don't worry.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I have some connections. We should get an answer of some kind.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The reason I called you today... I heard you asked Patello about a beastkin legend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The beastkin in that legend went up to the Blind Bird's Nest during the Sky of Chaos, and must have met a god there.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: That's all the people of Devesis know, and all I told Patello...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: But there was one more thing I saw when I escaped from that spirit twenty-five years ago...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was it?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: When something like a glass wall broke, and I felt I'd returned to the ordinary world, I encountered an old memory dwelling there...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I'd forgotten it for so long, but since Likimo Pelke disappeared, it's been returning little by little.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The moment a beastkin named Talos touched a great mirror...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Someone's figure appeared in it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it Belial?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: No. Someone with rabbit ears...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you remember anything else?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I wish I could tell you more, but that was all I saw. Like a fragment of memory...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see... Thank you, Marta.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Judging by your expression, that helped. Are you leaving Devesis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, there's just somewhere I need to visit. Please look after Elliot while I'm gone.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Don't worry. Shuvie is watching him, and everyone else is keeping an eye on him, too.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: But what could have happened to Elliot? He says he left Linford three years ago...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The road to Linford was cut off by an unknown force ten years ago... Part of the route from Whispering Hill to Aether Road is blocked by something like a wall of powerful magic.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The imperial family and assembly said they would resolve it through the Magic Bureau and various religious orders, but made little progress...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: As time passed, people gradually forgot Linford...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Linford... The city of angels with a fragment of the Celestial Realm...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see... I'll hear more from Elliot when I return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, Marta.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Have a safe trip.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm only going to Kali to rest. Nothing that would worry Iris should happen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What could happen...?

steps.name: A Noisy Reunion
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in 「Kali」, then go to [Beinan]. After talking to Beinan, return to [Medea] and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...It's a lovely day, so I was going to have tea outside. You've arrived at just the right time.
(Medea gently offers %s a cup of tea.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Thank you, Medea. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Since returning from Lindos, I've been living peacefully in the village with Hilda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, it smells lovely. Different from the tea we had before.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. Io made tea bags from flowers and herbs that grow only in Gerda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Such a nice fragrance.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: When you first came to the village, I never imagined we'd share tea like this... We truly cannot know what lies ahead.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To think a day would come when the Kali people no longer suffer in Eastland...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's all thanks to you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all. I hardly...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Aren't you a little too humble for the hero who saved Eastland? I've seen plenty myself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Hilda. When did you get here?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I was bored, so I took a walk around the village. You know I still can't go outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, what exactly have you seen? How long have you known about me?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hmm... Since you arrived in Eastland? It's a long story... And I don't particularly want to tell it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What brings you to Kali? You didn't come because you missed me... Daphne, I suppose?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, sit down. Would you like tea?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, what happened after we parted?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Quite a bit... I ended up going to a place called Nidaros in Alfheim...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Hilda and Medea what happened from Nidaros to Devesis.)
(Their expressions gradually stiffen as they listen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Medea. I wanted this to be a pleasant visit.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No. Thank you for telling us. Somehow, I feel your coming to Kali may not be a coincidence...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: With Daphne, it's possible. Sigh.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s... I know you want a proper answer to that question... But even I don't know.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I doubt witches will be freed from their lives simply because Daphne destroys Hecate, who imposed those lives on them...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In the worst case, the world's very rules could change...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The best solution would be for Hecate to change her mind, but that is extremely unlikely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And Daphne won't change her mind, either... We'll have to face her eventually...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The item that's nearly finished should help stop Daphne.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An item?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Remember what I took from Dmitri in Lindos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you'd leave it with Glinda?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea and I went to collect it recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is it? How do we use it?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It needs a little longer, but not much. Could you wait in Kali for a while?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why does it feel like the village is shaking? Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The elder is coming.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s... I'm sorry, but would you bring her here while we prepare the meal?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Shynic, you've arrived.
(Beinan stares at the little girl sprawled on the ground.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You used to help me up. Now you just leave me here. Hmph, no fun.
(Beinan helps Shynic up and brushes off the dust.)

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: As I always say, this puts us in a difficult position...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What's difficult? It's not my first visit to Kali.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: How many barriers have you broken by rushing here without controlling your magic?!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sorry ♡

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: That was a quick apology...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea told me to admit my mistakes quickly.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Using Medea as an excuse... That's low... I mean, understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beinan, I'll take Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wow, it's been so long ♡
(The moment Shynic sees the adventurer, she runs into their arms.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You never came to visit. Is it fun abandoning me for another continent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: People will get the wrong idea.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I nearly died of boredom ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're still alive, so I see you've been well.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: %s... You've changed a lot. Handling Shynic so smoothly...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I know. When you first came to see me, you were terrified...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, I was.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Oh, the time... %s, look after Shynic. I need to patrol Adrika...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem to have changed a little, too, Beinan.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Have I? I'm glad you think so.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glad?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Yes, glad. Enjoy your visit, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Bye! See you next time ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we go, too?

steps.name: Going Alone Is No Fun
steps.objective: Talk to [Marta] in 「Devesis」, then turn in the quest to [Shynic] in 「Avalon Outskirts」.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Do you like the food?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, delicious.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry to keep making you come here. I meant to visit Tartaros and see Noel, too...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's fine, it's fine. You had your reasons. Kali isn't far from Tartaros. I can just run over ♡

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: About you, elder.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What is it, little one?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You and Medea seem close. When I first came to Eastland, the Transcendents didn't get along.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's ancient history. But you! Medea gets called Medea, so why am I 'elder'?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You're older than Medea.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What was it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: May I teach this little brat a lesson? I won't kill her. Just enough to keep her alive ♡
(Shynic smiles coldly at Hilda, and a chilling presence sweeps into peaceful Kali.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, you're only saying that, aren't you? Hilda, stop provoking her.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You're both my valued guests, but if you cause trouble in Kali, I won't stand by...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Do you both understand?
(Medea smiles and looks from Hilda to Shynic.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Medea is angry...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes. Understood.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Sorry, elder.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: How about 'big sister' instead of 'elder'?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You're not my family. I'll just use your name.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Fine. Whatever you like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, Hilda, are you all right today?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I haven't had Medea's help today, but I'm better than expected.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Come to think of it, your souls have the same texture, don't they? It wouldn't be strange for either of you to collapse...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: In the old days, many died that way and went to the Netherworld.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It was an ability I never wanted, but I'm glad it helped Hilda.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm all right, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Where's Minuet, anyway? I haven't seen her lately.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems she's become able to leave Adrika. She said she's traveling around the continent.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Atkina told me Iris felt sorry for Minuet walking barefoot and gave her shoes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So she's doing well.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As long as she's well, I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, I have a favor to ask...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just say it. Anything short of dying ♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Could you find a Gem of Unity for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A Gem of Unity? What's that?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: A rare item that's been found around Eastland since long ago.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's used to reinforce places made of magic. That's how it got its name.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thanks to Shynic, we have none left. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Could I help in my own way instead of finding a gem?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Well... Because of Daphne, I need to rebuild the barrier myself using a Gem of Unity. I don't think another method will work...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All I need is the gem.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll get it. How many?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: One will do.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The magical beasts hide them well. Give them a scolding, and they'll hand one over.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Shynic?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You're coming with me. Going alone is boring. Aren't you coming?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose I have to?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, exactly ♡ Come on!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. No choice, then. Since I'm back in Eastland after so long, I'll go with Shynic.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You came to rest and don't even get to. What a shame...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I only meant to ask Shynic...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fine. I'll come back quickly and rest then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic, where are we going?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: A ranch full of fierce, ugly, but cute magical beasts. You'll like it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A ranch... with magical beasts?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's really fun ♡ Just come along, okay?

steps.name: Let's Teach Those Magic Beasts a Lesson ♡
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Shynic] in 「Avalon Outskirts」, then enter 「Camelot Ranch」.
2. Defeat [Captain Camelot] in 「Camelot Ranch」 and obtain the <Gem of Unity>. Go outside and turn in the quest to [Shynic] in 「Avalon Outskirts」.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So that's what was happening in Freios. And you resolved all of it. Impressive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all. All I did was...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I know. All for our novice goddess and everyone else. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Shynic seems a little different from before.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So think of this as doing another little chore for them, okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. By the way, that outfit... I don't think I've seen it before.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Only noticed now? Isn't it pretty? I commissioned it from Crisien.
(Shynic spreads her arms and moves about in front of %s to show off her new outfit.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's lovely. It has a similar feel to your old one, but looks lighter. Almost like a school uniform.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Really? I never went to school, so maybe I wanted to try the feeling.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I wanted to have one made in this style for Medea, too, but she looked so stern I was hurt.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Her face froze like she'd never speak to me again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone has different tastes.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea is tall, so airy outfits do suit her better.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Anyway, she said only I could pull off something this cute, so it's fine ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad. Oh, that at your waist...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It belonged to a friend you know, too. I want to keep remembering them, so I'll wear it here. Pretty, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought about keeping them only in my heart, but I didn't like that. Better to always be together.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's not difficult, after all.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Thank you, %s. You know how I feel, right? If not, I might kill you ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course I do. Oh, something looks strange over there.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Looks strange to you too, right? The ranch starts there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To think there's a place in Avalon where flowers and trees grow so thickly...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Welcome to my Camelot Ranch, full of magical beasts ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. Your Camelot Ranch? You own it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Didn't I tell you? I'm the ranch owner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I knew you liked cute things, but I didn't know you ran a ranch for magical beasts.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Even though it's part of polluted Avalon, clean, untainted grass and trees grow well here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Plants transplanted from elsewhere all died, but ones moved from near this ranch survived.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I think it has something to do with the magical beasts, but I'm not sure yet. I'll study it some more. I have plenty of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They don't look like they'd be obedient. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, it's fine. I give them as much fun as they give me ♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When they hear I'm here today, they'll rebel. Last time was the 145th, I think...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe. Number 146 should be fun, too. Let's go teach them a lesson together ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... You've counted them all...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic, do you think we'll find a Gem of Unity quickly?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The Deimos zealots brought magical beasts here to raise as weapons, but also to search for things like that.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I found some useful items during the 48th, 91st, and 138th rebellions. Not Gems of Bonds, but things useful for rebuilding Tartaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That doesn't sound like very good odds...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, don't worry. This time it's certain. I recently saw their leader hiding one away carefully.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I left it to collect next time. Let's go get it. It'll be fun ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure it'll be fun for you...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe. Hurry. Let's have a wonderful time putting down the magical beasts' 146th rebellion ♡
(Following Shynic through what appears to be the ranch entrance, I find a landscape unlike the Avalon I briefly visited.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To think this land connects to Avalon... Amazing. It looks like the peaceful ranch people usually imagine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Untainted green grass, beautiful flowers and trees, and rolling around on them... animals?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Magical beasts.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That one lying over there is a Camelot. Strange-looking, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Some black thing with a cat's expression wearing a capybara skin. I thought it was grotesque at first, but it grew on me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't know how the zealots brought them from the Demon Realm, but they probably meant to use them to attack people or defend Avalon.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Life here must be easier than in the Demon Realm. They only eat, sleep, and roll around, so the zealots seem to have given up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And these creatures rebel?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You know magical beasts' nature. Absolute loyalty to the strong.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: They have a leader. It keeps stirring the others into rebellion. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You have to admire its persistence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...There's something else besides Camelots over there.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text:
Those cute magical beasts are Suricatas.
They resemble desert animals called meerkats. The zealots brought them from the Demon Realm, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Quite a feat, bringing them here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well, there are plenty of ways. They had no interest in anything but playing with the Camelots.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But when they saw me scolding the Camelots, they suddenly put on armor, took up weapons, and attacked.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So I played with them a lot, and they settled down ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about those flying ones? Prirings?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Those are Weedlings. They were ordinary Prirings living nearby, but eating leftovers from the Camelots and Suricatas turned them into living herbs. They became magical beasts.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: See the leaves on their heads? Eating them can amplify magic or curses, grant immunity to certain conditions, and help with skin regeneration, synthesis, and healing.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you're not making medicine, wash them well and eat them with meat. Delicious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Is that really all right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I already called in that meat-loving man and finished testing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, Valdrick...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The ones near the entrance are tame. I've scolded them so much that they listen now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which means the ones over there...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Looks like they're preparing their 146th rebellion. The moment we cross this line, they'll swarm us.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now, %s. Let's make a bet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A bet?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Whoever finds and defeats the Captain Camelot and takes the Gem of Unity first wins. The loser dies ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm going ahead!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Shynic! Shynic!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's gone. Whew. I can't die like this... Better find the Captain Camelot.
(After fighting off charging magical beasts for some time, the adventurer looks around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. So many magical beasts. How many are there...? I think I've searched everywhere, but no sign of the Captain Camelot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, what's that?
(The adventurer's gaze rests on a worn little bed that looks as though a large animal sat on it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Judging by the size, it's not for a little Camelot. Does it belong to the captain?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Something's glittering there...
(Just then, an enormous shadow falls behind the adventurer.)
(The adventurer tries to retreat, but a huge hand catches them and lifts them upside down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Captain Camelot...?
(The adventurer meets the eyes of a bizarre black magical beast with a catlike expression inside an enormous capybara muzzle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: L-let go! Why are you so strong?
(The Captain Camelot ignores the adventurer's struggles and shakes them. It pokes them with its other hand, then opens its mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you going to eat me?
(At those words, its unreadable expression turns into a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not getting eaten like this!
(Still in the captain's grip, the adventurer swings with all their strength and drives both feet into its eyes.)
Thud.
(The Captain Camelot drops the adventurer and covers both eyes in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So the thing inside its mouth was its true body...
(The captain rubs its eyes, looks at the adventurer, and unleashes a metallic roar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what power. Its roar alone keeps pushing me back...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll need an opening to grab the jewel and leave. Huh?
(The Captain Camelot crosses its arms into an X and shakes its head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No?
(It forms a circle with both hands and nods. Then it clenches its fists and raises them toward the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want to fight.
(As the adventurer raises their weapon, the ranch's magical beasts rush in as though waiting for this moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. What a bother.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's do this.
Thud.
(%s's attack knocks the Captain Camelot off balance, and it falls backward.)
(It gets up to charge again, but flinches at %s's gesture. Then it sits down and flops onto its back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing?
(In answer, the captain takes out a little white flag and waves it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Admitting defeat? No more fighting?
(The captain clasps its hands and pretends to cry while begging.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I hope it won't attack me from behind...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I take the jewel now?
(Instead of answering, the captain picks up the old bed and shakes it. Several glittering jewels fall out.)
(The captain picks up the jewels and offers them to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm. It doesn't seem hostile anymore...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good job. Here, have this.
(The adventurer takes Lumen jerky from their pocket, puts it in the captain's mouth, and scratches its belly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's have a look...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Probably not this blue jewel. This purple, rabbit-shaped one... Could it be...?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's right.
(Shynic's sudden appearance startles the captain. It drops its jerky and slowly backs away.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Captain Camelot, I'm looking forward to rebellion number 147 ♡
(The captain trembles, grabs its jerky, and hastily flees.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehehe. That was fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I wanted to see how you'd do, so I told another beast at the entrance that my subordinate was coming this time. They excitedly prepared rebellion number 146.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Camelots are hard to tame. Being tamed wounds their pride. Beasts like that sometimes become so angry they kill themselves...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So you have to break their spirits a little, then let them recover. At least until I've properly transplanted all these flowers and trees throughout Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Your intentions are good, but it feels strange.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm not conspiring with them, so it's fine ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But you said my guess about this jewel was right.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes. The rabbit witch made it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don't look so surprised. Let's get outside first. You don't want to fight more beasts, do you?

steps.name: I Have to Hurry Back
steps.objective: Talk to [Shynic] in 「Avalon Outskirts」, then turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Kali」.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Want to hear the story?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think this is the place.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Since it concerns the rabbit witch, better to hear it from Medea, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's do that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can we just leave the ranch like this, though? All we've done is scold the magical beasts...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's fine, it's fine. Don't worry ♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The Captain Camelot will be so frustrated at failing that it'll gather the beasts and plot rebellion number 147.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: They're simpler than you'd think. They don't realize this is what I want. It'll stay like this until Avalon is purified ♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I told the meat fool to come blow off steam sometimes, too. It'll be fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm starting to feel sorry for the magical beasts...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Let's go to Kali. Medea will be waiting.

steps.name: Steps toward Home
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in 「Kali」, then turn in the quest to [Shynic] in 「Underground City Tartaros」.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's about time they returned.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Is everything ready?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'd like to go check, too... But I can't, can I?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, please wait here. It's still dangerous outside. I know the place well. I'll go and bring it back.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Will that end it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We must hope so.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There was a time when I thought the suffering hanging over this continent would never end.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But when I met everyone and went outside, I began to believe. To hope that everything could end...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This time, too, I believe... and hope everyone's suffering will end.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There they are.
(Shynic stretches out her little arms and waves vigorously at Medea, then runs into her embrace.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: We're back ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We're back.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm glad you returned safely.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The ranch's beasts can only be so scary. Though the one I saw long ago was different... It really came as though it would swallow everything...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Enough old stories. Here's the Gem of Unity. This will do, right, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. Thank you, Shynic. It's been so long since I saw this gem... Sigh. A rabbit, of all shapes...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It feels unpleasant...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hilda, hate Daphne if you want, but don't hate rabbits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The rabbits are innocent.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Well, yes, but...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, explain to %s why this gem is shaped like a rabbit. They're curious.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I see. Then I'll tell you about it. It's not a grand story...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Long ago, just as we do now, the Kali people layered barriers around the village to conceal it and keep outsiders out.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: These purple gems reinforce barriers, but they always broke, unable to harmonize with the Kali barrier.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Perhaps their power was insufficient. Daphne extracted my magic to strengthen a Gem of Unity. For some reason, she carved it into a rabbit. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It kept the old Kali village safe for a while, but that peace did not last...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There should be only one rabbit-shaped Gem of Unity... And now it has returned to my hands.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I want to believe her concern for our people is real.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was this intentional...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The gem is simply a means of building the barrier. I will try not to dwell on anything beyond that.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In any case, I'll rebuild it. This will make it stronger than before. Even Shynic rushing in won't break it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay, understood ♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But please walk in normally next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, how do you make a barrier with this gem?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: While you were at the ranch, I reworked the spell and spread it throughout the village.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now only this remains.
(Medea drops the Gem of Unity into a prepared hole, covers it with soil, then taps the spot with her staff.)
(Violet magic rises and envelops all of Kali.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I can feel the resolve to protect the village...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wow, wonderful. I'm glad we went.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, what is it?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There's something I'd like you to help Medea with.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course I'll help. What is it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You remember what fell from the Twisted One Dmitri in Lindos Holy Land?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you were making some kind of orb.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We made this black orb, but it needs to be more complete.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We must prevent it from happening, but if Daphne tries to harm Iris, we will need it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do we need to complete it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll have to go there to know. It's somewhere I never wanted to return to... But I intend to go tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Where the old Kali village stood?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. Mistwood, our people's homeland.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Do you remember the way?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No... I no longer have those memories...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hilda can't go outside, and %s probably doesn't know the way, either.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I have a good idea ♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What was it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Take me. I know the way. I'll go to Tartaros and get ready.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, come to Tartaros with Medea tomorrow morning. I'll be waiting ♡ Medea, make sure you wear that outfit. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic? Shynic?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wait, Shynic. Hold on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, she's gone...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...That's Shynic.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I thought she might know the way, but I didn't expect us to go together like this... No helping it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, I'll be counting on you tomorrow. Rest comfortably in the village today, and we'll go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Medea. I'm glad I can help.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mistwood, where the old Kali village stood... I wonder what it's like. I'll find out when we get there...)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's finish everything and go back... To where I belong...

steps.name: Like Going on an Outing
steps.objective: Talk to [Shynic] in 「Underground City Tartaros」, then turn in the quest to [Jenna] in 「Zisk Plains」.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvic, I'll be back soon. Medea will arrive shortly.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shynic, where are you going? And Medea is coming?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Didn't I tell you?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: No. You didn't.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: We're going to where the Kali people's old village was.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Before they came to Adrika, then. Noel told me about it once.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea has a little unfinished business, so I'm helping. Sounds fun, right? ♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I don't know about fun, but I hope you can be of great help to her.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Medea is my benefactor, just as you are.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe. You've grown, Melvic. Saying things like that.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You seem to forget sometimes, Shynic, but I'm already an adult.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I know. Then be as adult as you like.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Just like you, Shynic. Thank you. Oh, Medea is coming. Noel seems to have escorted her from the entrance to Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Medea, I'm so glad you've come to Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry, Noel. I have business today, so I can't stay with you long.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: It's all right. But did you have an outfit like this? Somehow, it seems a little lacking...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I gave it to her.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Of course! You have such an eye for clothes, Shynic. Medea's figure makes even this look good. Wow, beautiful!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Right? Pretty, isn't it? Wait here a moment. I'll go change ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while, Noel. You've become quite smooth.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: You do what you must to make a living. Hehe. Have you been well, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have. You too?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: It's easier to travel around Eastland now, and business is good. I've saved some Ely, too. Still a long way from opening a shop, though.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...Well done.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: It's thanks to you, Shynic, and %s. Hehe. Have a wonderful time. I'd better go.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'll take my leave, too. Noel, a moment. There's something I'd like to obtain through you...

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Really, Melvic? I'm delighted. This way, then. Come on, come on.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Noel has grown so much. I worried when Noel left the village, but I think everything will be fine now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Working hard toward a dream.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: All right, did I keep you waiting?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry for all this...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No, no. I'm doing it because I want to. I simply want to help.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The shortest route from here goes through Zisk Plains. Near the lake, I think. Let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The lake? If we're nearby, could we stop to see someone?

steps.name: The Road to the Misty Forest
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Jenna] in 「Zisk Plains」, then use the portal to 「Mistwood」.
2. Once all conversations are over, enter 「Mistwood」 and defeat [Weedling A], [Meerkat Knight], and [Busy-Eating Camelot]. Then turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Mistwood」.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Are these the right lyrics? Hmm. Ah, ah...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Memories fallen into the lake do not stay forever ♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I reach to hold them, but they flow away and never return ♩

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: If you wish to go back, all you can do is remember ♪
Clap, clap!
(Jenna startles at applause from somewhere and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: You startled me. I thought a ghost had appeared... Oh, I'm the ghost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Have you been well, Jenna?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Adventurer, Medea, it's been so long. I'm always well. And is that Shynic?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ziskad's little sister?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That's right. That man's little sister.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You look alike.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: What brings all three of you here? It doesn't seem ordinary...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: We're going to where the Kali people's village stood long ago. There should be a path up ahead.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Have you visited the territory before? Yes, that's the road to Mistwood.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When Ixion treated me as a weapon, I think we passed through Zisk Plains and came nearby, supposedly to wipe out the Deimos zealots.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's ancient history. I'm fine. That villain is gone.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: If you don't mind, may I ask something...? Is your visit connected to that person?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch...?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: If you mean the rabbit witch, no. Someone who looked like Gaia.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You saw Minuet. She used to be Gaia's incarnation, but now she's been blessed and travels the continent of her own free will...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: She looked dazed, as though something had enchanted her. I'm a little worried.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You wouldn't know, Jenna, but Minuet always looks dazed.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Does she?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She probably just crossed the territory and went that way. Minuet will be fine. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Jenna, we're going there on separate business. Nothing to do with Minuet. Please don't worry.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: All right... Are you leaving right away?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry we have to leave so soon after meeting again.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: It's fine. I'm glad I saw you at all. May I at least see you to Mistwood's entrance?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I can't go far, but I can reach there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Follow me, everyone.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: This is the boundary between the territory and Mistwood.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Straight ahead to Mistwood... Yes, I remember.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'll head back, then. Please take care.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: See you next time, Jenna.
(Jenna waves goodbye, then vanishes on the spot as though evaporating.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: A suitably ghostly departure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: An old memory came to mind...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Long ago, a beautifully shining forest stood here...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Probably over there...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ixion said there was a village somewhere here where a mysterious people called the Kali lived.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The old man wanted the Kali's power, too, but couldn't find them. His magic was running out.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: ...As I grew stronger as his weapon, I kept eating away at his magic...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I sensed magic somewhere in Mistwood, but kept my mouth shut.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If he'd found the Kali then, I would have died, too. He wouldn't have needed me anymore.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: And we would never have met.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Whew. Enough old stories. Shall we go? A little farther...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: ...Medea, do you feel that?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong, you two?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's where Kali village stood... There seems to be something there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...Yes... I can feel something like the old village, but something is unfamiliar...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you see that? The magical beasts from Camelot Ranch are here. Why?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't think it's the ranch's beasts... It feels as though something is waiting for us.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: All the escaped ones are here. That settles it...
(Shynic takes the Death Scythe from her shoulder in both hands. Medea tightens her grip on her staff.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then let's give it a proper greeting ♡ And scold our ranch's beasts while we're at it!

steps.name: A Past Trapped in a Curse
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Medea] in 「Mistwood」, then enter 「Spiral of Silence」.
2. Defeat [Minuet of the Spiral] in 「Spiral of Silence」 and obtain the <Void Stone>. Be sure to leave through the reward room, then turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Mistwood」.

lines.text: (After driving away some escaped beasts, they reach their destination. Medea sees an enormous pillar of light and sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes... Just some old memories...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's been so long...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I could have come before. Why did I only come now...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'm so late...
(Medea closes her eyes and quietly raises her staff, sensing the surging pillar of light.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shall we rest and talk before going in? Ask anything you'd like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's barren now, but long ago this was a forest always filled with mist.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Outsiders were drawn by the mysterious sight of a forest seemingly swallowed by fog. Most became lost.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Those who wandered in circles and barely escaped called it the mysterious forest, Mistwood, and rarely approached again.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, the Kali village stood in this forest. Its name was Kali then, too...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A place our people loved and cherished...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I never thought I'd return... We truly cannot know what life holds...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sigh. I suppose I can't help being shaken...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Many memories. Though I cannot tell which are truly my own...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think I was very happy until we left this place.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As a child, I ran along the forest paths with friends. The adults put signs everywhere to keep us from getting lost.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: At dusk, the children went home. An adult would take my hand, lead me to a meal, and put me to bed.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then one day, the mist vanished and darkness came... As you can imagine, within it were the Deimos zealots and the one leading them.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Vice...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. At his gesture, screams filled the forest. I was so confused I didn't know what to do...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To think I'm telling you all this. I must trust you a great deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Medea...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I believe Freios has a similar term. Think of it as a vortex of magic...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A pillar formed from countless lines of light... At some point, I began seeing those lines. No one besides Daphne and me could see them.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I asked her what they were, but she brushed it off.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I thought it was nothing, too. But eventually, the villagers began to see them.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then one day, the lines erased the mist surrounding Kali. The Deimos zealots hunting our people invaded.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That day, as agonized screams filled the forest, she made a choice to save our people...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She pulled the lines of light apart and scattered them through the air. The village became enclosed in the space they formed.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Zealots who touched the lines screamed and melted. But it didn't end there. The lines trapped part of the village, too.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Only we can see this pillar now, but it is made of many lines of light. There is a path between them.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A space filled only with silence within a twisted spiral... The Spiral of Silence...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What we're looking for is here, then? So we need to go inside those lines of light...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea... About this...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please, go on...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Those lines... A greater power than the Wheel is at work here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I accidentally pierced the great wall with the Wheel, but it's still only a place where Transcendents and others connected to gods can come and go.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But this seems to have been made by pulling in part of the great wall itself. It's on a completely different level...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That was centuries ago... Daphne drew on divine power even then?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I became certain while purifying the fragment from the Twisted One at Hilda's request.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That she is capable of wielding power like this...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And that something connected to gods must be somewhere in the old Kali village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why would such a thing be in Kali?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Perhaps she needed it to make me a perfect witch...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sniff, sniff. I smell it. I definitely sense something. We'd better find it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's find it quickly and finish the item. Do we go straight inside?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There used to be no way in. But now there is.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The little girl has grown stronger than she was then.
(Medea raises her staff, and the pillar of light called the Spiral of Silence surges.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, use your Death Scythe to cut through the tightly bound lines and make an opening.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay.
(Shynic leaps up and swings her Death Scythe at the pillar. It parts slightly, revealing a gap.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: ...It's closing again. One strike won't be enough.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll keep shaking it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can do?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We'll keep holding the pillar open. Someone needs to search for the item. Please.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, this is the home you've wanted so badly to return to. Go together and find it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll manage somehow. Don't worry. Go on ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, let's trust Shynic and go.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Shynic. We'll be quick.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Leave it to me ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll be back.
(Leaving Shynic behind, the two leap between the parted lines of light.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Perse, could you open the Netherworld's gate for a moment? I need a little power.
(A black sphere filled with magic from somewhere rises above Shynic's head.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now, shall I give it a good slashing? ♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Cough, cough... %s, cover your mouth.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Medea.
(Medea raises her staff and strikes the ground. The surrounding darkness retreats.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...It should be better now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...
(The adventurer's eyes dart about, taking in the world within the gap.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The old Kali village...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As though cursed... No, it is cursed. Trapped in a spiraling vortex of magic...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's similar to the current village, yet so different...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Aside from the strange plants growing everywhere, yes...
Medea...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That voice?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Could it be...
Medea? It's been so long...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, do you recognize the voice?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Villagers I lived with long ago. People no longer in this world...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Don't listen. They're false voices made by the demons that attacked the forest with the Deimos zealots.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So clear, even after all this time.
Medea, why are you only here now? We've been waiting.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Half the villagers survived thanks to Daphne's choice. The others could not be saved...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The survivors didn't resent Daphne for making the Spiral of Silence and disappearing. Instead, they pitied me, left behind.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: They must have known. That I had remained unchanged for so long, so Daphne could make me a perfect witch.
Medea, come play. Did Daphne lock you up again?
Would you like some bread, Medea? You must have been hungry.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And that I was frightened in that situation...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The Kali people didn't hate me. They gave me strength...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: They sacrificed themselves and asked me to save the young villagers...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: From the moment I received their power, I became a Transcendent in Eastland, understanding part of divine power. Some of the witch's power Daphne had planted within me awakened, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I used to hate what I was. But now I've accepted it all.
Save us, Medea. Are we going to die like this...?
Medea, it's your fault. We're dying because of you.
The Kali were attacked because you were here...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If the false voices keep coming, demons must be trapped here, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We should be careful... Are you all right, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Once, this would have broken me. But not now. Whew. Would you look over there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The lines in the sky are moving...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think something is happening somewhere over there.
Medea... Save us...
Daphne abandoned us and ran away... I don't want to die...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Foolish demons...
(Medea raises her staff toward the sky, revealing demons hidden behind something unseen.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: On our way to the end, we'll encounter demons that tormented the villagers and me like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's reassuring. I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: False voices, then illusions... Demons still bring out the very worst...
(Medea strikes the last demon's head with her staff. It writhes, lets out a hideous sound, and evaporates.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As always, fighting demons and magical beasts like these feels awful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think we've searched the whole old village... But there's no sign of what we need.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There's something over there.
(Someone slowly emerges in the direction Medea is watching.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia?
(As the adventurer starts forward, Medea catches their hand.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No... Gaia is asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could she have awakened again?
(As the figure resembling Gaia approaches, Medea startles and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Minuet...?
(The being turns toward them at her name, and the entire space begins to shake.)
(Minuet, looking like a fallen Gaia, prays and raises her hands toward the sky. Enormous plant stalks burst forth and attack them.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Minuet, stop!
(Light flows from the tip of Medea's staff and counters Minuet's attack.)
(But Minuet shows no sign of stopping, continuing to create vortices of light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, is there a way to stop her?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Could it be...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, listen carefully. There's only one way to restore Minuet now. In this situation, it's our best option...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We must overpower that force with our own. Then we can save Minuet and find the item.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we have no choice.
(The adventurer meets Minuet's emotionless gaze and quietly tightens their grip on their weapon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, I'm sorry. Hold on a little longer.

lines.speaker: 나선의 미뉴에트
lines.text: Aaah!
(At Minuet's scream, the thorny vines surging as though alive shatter like glass and fall to the ground.)
(The black shadow surrounding Minuet begins to fade.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now! Strike this light as hard as you did before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right!
(%s's weapon strikes the transparent light Medea created. It splits into several streams and flows toward the suffering Minuet.)
(The light envelops Minuet up to her head, erasing her darkened appearance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?
(The black shadow vanishes completely. Freed of the evil presence, Minuet sinks to the ground in a cold sweat.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Hah... Hah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: ...Blank...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wake up, Minuet!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Medea...?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Why are you two here...? What was I doing?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You don't remember anything?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I came here while traveling, then seem to have lost consciousness...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Did this call me...?
(Minuet takes something from her clothes and shows Medea and %s. Bead-like objects in a bottle glow softly.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To think this was what did that to Minuet... Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, please explain. Is this what we're looking for?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It feels strangely nostalgic... This belongs to the ancient gods...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's only natural that Minuet, Gaia's incarnation, would react to this.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'd forgotten all this time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did Daphne intend to do with it?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: ...Is Shynic nearby?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She came with us. She's outside helping us stay inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I think she's drawing on the Netherworld's power...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This won't do. Let's get out quickly. I'll explain once we're outside.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Minuet, can you run?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There's a shortcut back to where we entered. Follow me!

steps.name: A Resolve to Remember
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in 「Mistwood」, then turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Kali」.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hold tight, Minuet.
(Medea pulls Minuet, who is struggling to get out, through the opening.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well, who is this? Hello, Minuet ♡
(Shynic wipes the sweat from her brow and catches the unsteady Minuet. Then she smiles brightly at the lines of light, closed once more.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's over. What a relief...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hm? Am I supposed not to be?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not that... Why did you use the Netherworld's power?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: How did you know? I meant to use it secretly... Oh, did Minuet tell you?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I could feel your suffering...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: My own power didn't leave much room to spare ♡ Anyway, I'm glad everyone got out safely.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, I'm fine. Really. It's only once in a while. I won't go berserk like before.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please don't do that again...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay, I'll be careful. Right, you came out because you found the item?
(Medea holds up the item for the curious Shynic.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So this is what Hilda was looking for. Strange-looking... Wait... This...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll explain everything here.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Daphne called this a Void Stone... Beads refined from some of the power extracted from an ancient god's remains...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know where she obtained it, but I know what she intended to use it for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As you know, I was meant to become a perfect witch at her hands. That required great power.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In the worst case, I might have become an artificial god...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Like Atalante...?)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: ...That mad rabbit witch! She was going to use this on you...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, it didn't happen. Please calm down.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But... All right.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The Deimos zealots' attack disrupted Daphne's plans.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know whether Daphne still needs the Void Stones. But for us, they've become ingredients for something we need in the coming battle.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No wonder their power affected Minuet and changed her like that.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She went berserk in a form resembling a fallen Gaia.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm sorry... I didn't mean to...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Minuet, are you back to normal now?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: ...Blank...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, the usual blank feeling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now we just need to bring this carefully to Hilda...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, what will you do with this place? The lines of light have faded a little, but I doubt they'll disappear completely...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This place is my past, my present, and my future. For as long as I live, I'll keep searching for a way to save it...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wonderful, Medea. That's my favorite thing I've heard lately ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been wondering, Minuet. When did you become able to leave Adrika?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: When I began wishing to truly experience life...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I think Gaia gave it to me as a gift...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'll part with you here... There are still so many places I haven't seen. I'd like to travel elsewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Will that be all right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: After this, I'm sure Minuet will be careful.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If it's not all right, we'll make it all right. Minuet, cause trouble and I'll scold you so hard I'll have to ask Gaia's forgiveness ♡

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes. I'll be careful...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'll go now... See you later...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Minuet.
(Minuet gives a small wave and walks away.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Minuet really has changed... Just as we have...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shall we return? Hilda will be waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Let's go.

steps.name: A Future beyond the Mist
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in 「Kali」, then go to [Beinan] in 「Kali」. Once everything is over, return to [Medea] in 「Kali」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Here...
(Medea places the bottle of shining beads in Hilda's waiting hand.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This will do. Where's Shynic?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Merimel asked for instruction and caught her.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I don't know why, but Shynic seems kind to Kali women...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do we use it now?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So impatient... %s, watch.
(Hilda puts the black orb from her hand into the bottle of beads and seals it.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The stones will soon dissolve and seep into the black orb. Here, take it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You can't use it immediately, but when the time comes, it should help somehow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Hilda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um... Never mind.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I know you and Medea have lots of questions for me, %s, but you're holding back.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If you want my story, let's deal with the villains first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yes. Once it's over, everything will work out... For me, too...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda? What did you say?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Nothing...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Come to think of it, %s, you haven't had a proper rest since coming here. Get some rest. We don't know what might happen.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry, %s. You came to Kali and spent all your time helping me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, people are gathering at the village entrance... What's happening? It's noisy. Has someone arrived?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, sorry. I'll hide for a bit.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What? Why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This could be troublesome...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Sorry. Just for a moment. I'll stay in the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's already gone. Where did she go?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We'll hear Hilda's story later. Let's go see...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Merimel, weren't you with Shynic just now?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I said I needed something, and she ran to Tartaros to bring it.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Merimel, wait. Shh. Come here.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Hm? Why?
(Beinan steps in front of Merimel and aims his bow at an approaching figure.)
Greetings, people of Kali.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: A d-dark elf...?
I'm neither a strange person nor a dangerous elf. Please calm down.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: ...Everyone who says that is strange and dangerous.
Not at all. I'm a wonderful elf. A cute, kind Kali girl like you simply must know that!

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Stop there. Don't come closer. Take one more step, and this arrow goes through your heart.
How harsh... Very well.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Answer my questions. Where did you come...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: What's a Dokkalfr?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Meriel, why are you interrupting...?
Oh, I should explain. In Freios, dark elves are also called Dokkalfr.
But we follow darkness, not evil. We're not bad elves. I suppose in Eastland we're simply considered bad.
Allow me to apologize on behalf of all elves. Surely you must accept an apology from a handsome young elven priest.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: How did you learn of Kali village? You're no ordinary person. Identify yourself...
Such a discerning eye. As you can see, I'm no ordinary person.
I'm Father Askren of the Immortal Priesthood, an order of elite priests within Freios's renowned Hodmis Order.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Not to boast, but I became its youngest fifth-rank priest. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: That's a lot of words. So what?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: ...It's a tremendous achievement! You have to work incredibly hard to reach fifth rank at my age! (Chokes up.)
(Just then, the chilling blade of a Death Scythe approaches Askren's neck.)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Aaaaaah! P-please spare me!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What are you? ♡

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh? Oooooh, this is Shynic's famous Death Scythe! I've heard so much about it.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Shynic, I'll handle this. Stand back.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It looks fun. I want to hear him out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Father Askren?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s, do you know how much I wanted to see you? You've already left Freios and come to Eastland!

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You truly appear and disappear without warning!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: ...What an exhausting person. If you know the adventurer, I'll stand down.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, do you know him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...He's the priest who helped me in Nidaros.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I see. Nice to meet you. I'm Medea of Kali village.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Wow. To meet the Medea and Shynic I've heard so much about!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You know me?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Well, the Order's secret records... Oops. Sorry. I meant to keep that secret, but apparently I can't. Think of it as fate and welcome me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You look amusing, too ♡

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Handsome rather than amusing, wouldn't you say?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: He's hard to deal with...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, no fun.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You're suspicious, Father, but for the sake of the Demigod behind you, I'll hear you out.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Demigod, stop hiding and come down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A Demigod? Is Frozen here?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Frozen is very busy and couldn't join this time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This time...?)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Someone else came instead.
(Askren points upward. Someone watching from a tall tree lands lightly.)
Kali is so beautiful that I was admiring it from above. Nice to meet you all.
(A woman brushes back her long pink hair, meets their eyes with a bright smile, and offers %s a handshake.)
I'm Lydia. And the spirit on my shoulder is Roro. Say hello, Roro.
(Demigod Lydia strokes the head of the spirit she introduced as Roro. Roro blinks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you're...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: The Lydia everyone you've met has talked about. One of the three Demigods. Ah, two now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. I'm %s... I didn't expect to meet you like this.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Nice to meet you. I didn't expect this introduction, either, but urgent business brought me to Kali.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: For a Demigod to come in person...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Merimel, Beinan, I'll take our guests. Please return to your work.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Merimel, here are your new tools. Take them.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Aah, Shynic, I love you!

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Medea, will you be all right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, I'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Understood...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lydia, Father, this way.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What could have brought Demigod Lydia and Father Askren here...?)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shall we talk over a cup of tea?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: I'm curious about Kali's tea, but telling %s why we came must come first. Let's save it for later.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Nervous?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels as though you're hesitating.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Pink Demigod, is it something fun?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The Order has many enjoyable duties.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Father Askren, stop talking and take out what you brought.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Sniff. Understood. Here...
(Askren takes a small stone tablet from his clothes and presents it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this? My name seems to be engraved on it...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: A tablet made from divine stone found in the place where Iris recovered after returning from the darkness.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: When someone's name appears on it, we find that person and have them read its contents.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why you came to me... What should I check?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Only the person receiving the oracle can read this tablet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An oracle?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Could it be...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Exactly. As the God of the Astral Realm, she has given %s her first oracle.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: A message delivered in a god's name may be a command or a prophecy. That's why we need to check.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to speak with Iris first...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: You can't. Even with your mental connection to her, once an oracle is issued, nothing else can be done.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Until whatever the oracle says is complete... That's part of the relationship between gods and humans...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: It may be hard to understand. This happened so suddenly. But that's the nature of an oracle... In any case, you trust Iris, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: You know she wouldn't lead you astray.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Now, %s. Put your hand on this tablet. You'll understand naturally.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: And quietly recite what it says. Please.
(Lydia gently takes %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're asking... All right.
(As the adventurer places a hand on the tablet, a vision of unknown light and darkness crossing unfolds before them.)
(A man stands before them, his appearance changed from before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos...? No, Kaulini...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...The one bearing the fate of a Demon God... waits in Amaranth Nova. Pierce his heart and destroy him...?
